info.name: Local REST API for Obsidian Active File Vault Files API
Return the content of a single file in your vault.

params.name: filename
params.description:
Path to the relevant file (relative to your vault root).
 Optionally, you may include a reference to a sub-part of the document to return; see "Targeting a Sub-part of your Document" for details.

items.docs:
Returns the content of the file at the specified path in your vault should the file exist.
